sources.snippet: This model detects 60 entity classes in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition screenshots. model.onnx contains the weights used by this project's Mac-hosted detector server. The model repository is an artifact registry, not a hosted inference API. Future versions replace model.onnx in a new commit ...
